# PureIntake

> PureIntake is a mobile-first web app for tracking daily calories, macros, meals and water intake against personal nutrition goals.

PureIntake lets you log foods from a searchable database, track water intake, browse daily and calendar history, and monitor progress toward calorie and macro targets. The app is account-based; most features require signing in, and each user's data is private.

## Core
- [Home](https://www.pureintake.app/): Landing and sign-in page

## Notes
- The app requires authentication; there is no public user content to index beyond the landing page.
- The backend API is private and not intended for crawling.
